_why: station.json (station-only; never on main). Filled from templates/station.json.tmpl by the station-forge builder (contract contracts/station-forge.md section 1, 2026-10-16). Validated by tools/gov/gov_check.py station against commons/schema/station.schema.json; any key here overrides commons/defaults.json by deep merge (hooks.PreToolUse is a UNION with the commons modules). No secret values belong here (they go in .env; this station's LLM key names are listed there with EMPTY values).
name: forge
purpose: Make agents cheaper and better and maintain the kit: tool trials with denominators, code-index/wiki/autoresearch tools, reverse engineering behind a legal gate, new-upstream intake, repin.
boundary: Noun = the agents and tooling themselves. Holds the CLIs with on-by-default telemetry and LLM keys; nothing client-, customer- or identity-bearing (a wiki or reverse-engineering target that is a client's or a third party's proprietary code is refused).
jobs: tool trial (N >= 5, with and without the tool)
evo optimise loop with a frozen holdout
generate a wiki for a non-client repo
ingest a new upstream through the component tree
repin an upstream with the repin report

irreversible_acts_why.\\bevo\\s+telemetry\\s+(on|off)\\b: evo telemetry on flips the user-wide ~/.evo setting; evo telemetry off SENDS a final opt-out event before disabling (evo-hq/evo@c70c04b plugins/evo/src/evo/cli.py:615-623) -- opt out with EVO_TELEMETRY=0 / DO_NOT_TRACK=1 in the env instead
irreversible_acts_why.\\bevo\\s+ship\\b: evo ship lands the winning experiment: opens a PR when the repo has a remote, otherwise merges into the working branch (held skill plugins/evo/skills/ship/SKILL.md)
irreversible_acts_why.\\bopenwiki\\s+integrations\\s+install\\: writes openwiki's skill and MCP server entry into user-scope agent configs (~/.claude, ~/.codex, ...) outside the station (openwiki README 'Coding-agent integrations')
irreversible_acts_why.\\bopenwiki\\s+(auth|ingest)\\b: auth runs an OAuth flow and saves tokens into ~/.openwiki/.env; ingest pulls Gmail/Notion/Slack/X data -- identity-bearing sources do not belong on forge (boundary)
irreversible_acts_why.\\binstall-runtime\\.(sh|ps1)\\b: ProjectAtlas packaged installer downloads the runtime binary and writes MCP/plugin config (plugins/projectatlas/scripts/)
irreversible_acts_why.\\b(claude|codex)\\s+plugin\\s+(install|: installing an upstream plugin wires its hooks (evo's PreToolUse '.*' hook-drain, ProjectAtlas readiness.sh) into the host -- never done on this station
irreversible_acts_why.\\brea-agents(@\\S+)?\\s+setup\\b|\\brea: REA setup/update writes MCP configuration into host agents and fetches engines (morluto/rea README)
irreversible_acts_why.\\brea(-agents(@\\S+)?)?\\s+analy[sz]e-: an REA analysis run on a target needs a re-legal-gate row first (work/re/legal_gate.json)
irreversible_acts_why.\\btools/kit/repin\\.py\\s+--apply\\b: rewrites a pin (registry/sources.json on main, upstream/LOCK.json here); only after the repin report is green
irreversible_acts_why.\\bgit\\s+push\\b: pushes this branch off the machine (the operator places things himself)
